author: Megan_J

title: Barcelona Bike Tour was excellent.  Paul knows the city so well!
text: Paul was an excellent guide.  So friendly and knowledgeable. We chose to go on standard bikes at a comfortable speed and we saw a lot of areas in the city including the beautiful waterfront.  We loved the gorgeous park that was a setting for the World's Fair.  We went through the 1992 Olympic Village.  We really enjoyed Paul and would easily recommend biking through the  beautiful city of Barcelona where the crowds are thinner.  It was a perfect morning choosing to do this biking your!
author: Maureen_H

title: Great Tour
text: On arrival bike was ready and waiting. After some introductions and safety advice off we went. The tour was at a good pace and good information was given at the “stops” Guide was extremely friendly and knowledgeable. Certainly saw parts of the city that I would not have on foot. Enjoyed!!
author: Alan_D

title: Highly recommend Paul's tour
text:
Paul's bike tour was the perfect first activity when we arrived in Barcelona. 

He asked us what we wanted from the tour and took us on a city overview ride to so many of the sights. From Sagrada Familia to the oldest sections of the walls, Paul included both history and day to day life in Barcelona. As we rode he also pointed out other places we should explore. 

Barcelona is a very bike-friendly city with bike lanes everywhere complete with separate bike signals. Paul made us feel very comfortable riding in a new city and carefully obeyed all the bike traffic rules. His bikes were in excelle

author: StevenVan_N

title: Here there and everywhere
text:
Really good way of seeing the city.

Paul the guide was very affable and answered all my questions with in depth knowledge.

I would recommend this tour on your first day as it is a great way to find your bearings and all the major landmarks of the city. 

Much easier than walking in the heat of the day.
author: Roving657667

title: Biking with Paul
text: Paul was personable and interesting!! He loves the city and we learned things we wouldn’t have just walking around. The biking was easy, just the biking lanes and lights were confusing but you get the hang of it. He supplied water and an apple for a mid morning snack. He was charming and friendly!!!
